rca of the issue: BUG RCA — /api/upstox/diagnostic upstox_token_present incorrect: server.py:837 reads `db.upstox_auth.find_one(...)` but tokens are persisted in `db.upstox_tokens` (see _get_active_token() server.py:262 which uses `db.upstox_tokens.find_one({"user_id": USER_ID, "is_active": True})`). The collection name was likely typed by analogy with the env var prefix UPSTOX_AUTH or the OAuth callback name. Reproduction: GET /api/upstox/diagnostic while /api/upstox/status returns connected:true → response shows `"upstox_token_present": false, "upstox_user": null`. Mitigation: replace the query with `await db.upstox_tokens.find_one({"user_id": USER_ID, "is_active": True}, {"_id": 0})` and source profile from doc.get('profile') if persisted there, else from a quick ux.get_profile(decrypted_token) call. Other diagnostic fields verified working (egress_ip='34.16.56.64', instruments_loaded=9249).
